name: The Channels Natural Area Preserve
method: shown as 'check': The Channels State Forest rules (State Forest Use Permit + hunting license) appear to apply
notes: Entirely inside The Channels State Forest (719 ac overlap); the preserve polygon has the smaller bounding box, so the app uses this entry rather than the forest's. DCR's preserve page says the preserve is part of the 4,836-ac state forest and is 'owned and managed by the Virginia Department of Forestry'; it says nothing about hunting. DCR's park regulations (4VAC5-30-30 and -240, no hunting except in designated areas) cover natural area preserves under DCR's management or control, which this one is not. DOF's Channels hunting map (8/14/23) shows the preserve inside the forest with no closed area and says DWR regulations for Washington/Russell counties apply with a State Forest Use Permit; DOF's 2026-27 season brief (updated 09/10/2026) covers the whole forest and does not mention the preserve. 4VAC10-30-200 allows state-forest hunting only in areas the State Forests Superintendent designates. No source says outright that the preserve is open, so it is 'check', not 'open'.
